doc.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Saudades and Grammy recognition across genres
summary: The Trio Beyond live record is nominated; he is unlikely to tour as a new-age artist.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Then your relationship with ECM… In 2006 you release, Saudades a live recording of Lifetime And Beyond. So that was when you released that trio.

That also received a Grammy nomination. So, your projects are receiving notice regardless of the genre whether it’s new age or jazz. That speaks to your versatility and perhaps to the integrity of your work that you can crossover to another field and still receive some recognition. I don’t know if you’re going to tour doing that but…
Touring as a new age artist as opposed to a jazz artist.
I don’t think so. I may make some more relaxation recordings, but I don’t
know about touring. If somebody out there makes me an offer I can’t refuse. [Laughs]
